result.question: Why did Uzziah dig cisterns?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain.
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, | dug many cisterns

assessments.reason: The text states, “Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns,” directly giving livestock as the reason for digging cisterns.

result.reason: The passage links digging cisterns to having much livestock, while loving the soil explains having farmers and vinedressers, not cisterns.
